case.summary: Case AUTO-003 was triggered by an autonomous monitor flagging transaction 3579943 for $249.94 because a device profile was shared as a new device by five customers on card C07212-K2. Investigation revealed that the device profile was already used five times on this card, the transaction amount was typical for the customer, and a prior alert (CC-3793) had been cleared as a false alarm. The cardholder was contacted and confirmed they made the purchase. The verdict is legitimate with no fraud pattern identified. The final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
